item.title: China lowers GDP growth target to 4.5-5 pc amid global, domestic uncertainties
item.description: Premier Li Qiang announces reduced growth goal at National People’s Congress, citing Trump’s trade war, US–Iran tensions, property slump and weak domestic demand

item.title: Global evacuation efforts intensify as nations race to bring home citizens from Gulf
item.description: Travellers scramble for escape routes while governments organise evacuation flights after the expanding Iran conflict disrupts tens of thousands of flights across the Middle East

item.title: Maharashtra transporters’ stir against e-challans; indefinite strike from midnight
item.description: Commercial vehicles, buses, and taxis to stay off roads as talks with government fail; sector seeks reforms, fine waivers, and relief from mounting costs

item.title: Congress announces 6 Rajya Sabha poll picks, Abhishek Singhvi renominated
item.description: Party also fields Phulo Devi Netam, Vem Narender Reddy, Karamvir Singh Boudh, Anurag Sharma and M Christopher Tilak for the March 16 biennial Rajya Sabha elections

item.title: Nitish Kumar to resign as Bihar CM, set to join Rajya Sabha amid protests
item.description: JD(U) president confirms he will step down after over two decades in office, fulfilling long-standing ambition to serve in all legislative Houses at both state and national levels

item.title: Stock markets rebound in early trade tracking rally in global peers
item.description: Benchmark indices rise as global markets recover despite West Asia tensions, with Sensex gaining over 550 points and Nifty climbing past 24,650

item.title: Why the Indian palette is not just about bright, stereotypical colours, but a sense of who we are
item.description: From the mineral palette of the earliest artists and pigments that yielded luminous yellows and deep blues, to the growth of aniline dyes in the late 19th century and revival of organic colours in the 21st century, India's colour palette continues to evolve.

item.title: Three Assam Congress MLAs join ruling BJP ahead of Assembly elections
item.description: Kamalakhya De Purakayastha, Sashikanta Das, and Basanta Das, along with two others, switch to BJP amid political realignments ahead of the Assembly elections

item.title: Explained: What is IRIS Dena and how the US-Iran conflict reached the Indian Ocean
item.description: Torpedo strike on Iran’s IRIS Dena in the Indian Ocean widens the US–Iran conflict beyond the Gulf, raising concerns over regional security and global shipping routes

item.title: Kerala HC rejects PIL to stop Assembly ethics panel probe against Rahul Mamkootathil
item.description: Court says it cannot direct Assembly Speaker on House proceedings; plea sought to halt ethics panel action against the expelled Congress MLA facing sexual assault cases
